Polygon Splitter.js

Hi,

it's a tool script to split polygon object by polygon selection. split object will be named 'originalname'_[polysel number].

I wrote this due to forum post.

place it into ~/Application Support/Cheetah3D/scripts/Tool folder.

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.

Attachments: [Polygon Splitter.js.zip](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/13607/)
